headline: Nigeria's SAHCO Pre-Tax Profit Falls 22.1% to N8.08 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc reported unaudited financial results for the nine-month period, showing pre-tax profit fell 22.13% to N8.08 billion.
why: SAHCO is a major aviation ground handling service provider in Nigeria, whose operating margins reflect domestic and international air traffic conditions and local inflation.

impacts.name: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc
impacts.why: A 22.13% year-on-year drop in pre-tax profit dampens bottom-line earnings performance.
